answer: An attacker thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The oasis counter is kept in tide and kernel reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3129 identities would post 4165 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
